title: ICSE Board Pattern Array Question Practice
prerequisites: 1D & 2D Arrays, Linear Search, Binary Search, Bubble Sort, Selection Sort
instructions: Section A carries 10 marks (short questions & outputs).
Section B carries 30 marks (two 15-mark programming problems with variable description tables).

questions.q: What is the prerequisite condition before executing Binary Search on an array?
questions.answer: The elements of the array MUST be sorted in either ascending or descending order.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of comparisons in Linear Search for an array of N elements?
questions.answer: N comparisons (in the worst case when the element is at the last index or absent).

questions.q: What is the output of: int[][] m = {{1, 2}, {3, 4}}; System.out.println(m.length + "," + m[0].length);?
questions.answer:
Output: `2,2`.
Reason: `m.length` gives the number of rows (2), and `m[0].length` gives the number of columns in row 0 (2).

questions.q: How many elements can be stored in `double[] scores = new double[15];`?
What is the return value of `java.util.Arrays.binarySearch(new int[]{10, 20, 30}, 25)`?
questions.answer: A negative integer (`-3`), indicating the insertion point `-(insertion_point + 1)`.

sections.description: Write complete programs with variable description tables.

questions.q: Write a program to accept 15 integer elements into a 1D array. Perform **Selection Sort** to arrange them in ascending order and display the sorted array.
questions.answer: Standard Selection Sort: find minimum element in unsorted subarray and swap with current index.
questions.hint: Find minIndex in inner loop, then swap.

questions.q: Write a program to input a 3x3 square matrix. Calculate and display the sum of the **Left Diagonal** and **Right Diagonal** elements.
questions.answer: Left diagonal condition: `i == j`. Right diagonal condition: `i + j == 2`.
questions.hint: Nested loop checking diagonal index conditions.
